name: Lamorinda
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A San Francisco Bay Area AVA east of the Berkeley Hills in Contra Costa County, named by blending Lafayette, Moraga and Orinda.
